title: On the spectra of Cantor measures
summary: We consider Cantor measures on the line, with contraction factor $N^{-1}=p^{-α}$ (where $p$ a positive prime, $α$ a positive integer) and $m$ positive integer digits lying in distinct residue classes modulo $N$. We obtain a complete characterization of maximal orthogonal sets of exponentials in $L^2(μ)$, for a class of such measures $μ$. It is proved that the $n+1$-th digit in the base-$N$ expansion of frequencies in a maximal orthogonal set, with the first $n$ digits prescribed, has $m$ possible values.
